item.title: Watchung Booksellers Hosts Bestselling Author Amanda Peters — Mon Sep 14, 7:00 PM — watchung booksellers the kids’ room
item.description:
Watchung Booksellers welcomes Amanda Peters, bestselling author of The Berry Pickers, for the release of her latest novel, The Birthing Tree, on Monday, Sept 14 at 7:00 p.m. Peters will be in conversation about the book with author Alice Elliott Dark. The Birthing Tree is an unforgettable novel about a woman who must confront her family’s buried truths and memories of passionate young love when her grandmother’s death leaves her as the only guide to her community’s future. Spanning decades of loss and reclamation, this sweeping yet intimate novel follows one woman’s journey to protect the land, the traditions, and the memory of the women who came before her—and to decide which parts of her inheritance she will carry into the future. Tickets are $5 and include a 10% discount on the book purchased at the event. To register, visit watchungbooksellers.com. Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

item.title: Practical Spanish 1 — Tue Oct 20, 6:15 PM — Montclair Main - Classroom
item.description:
This is a paid Adult School class. Click here to register.
This class is for those of you who know little to no Spanish and are interested in acquiring some practical communication skills. You will be introduced to basic greetings and practice useful questions and answers. You will learn the fundamentals of Spanish pronunciation while mastering introductory grammar and vocabulary.
Topics covered:
conversation/questions greetings personal information expressions of courtesy feelings asking for direction talk about needs and want where people are from. Alphabet Numbers/Days/date Colors Basic commands Some ar/er/ir regular verbs Verb to be: ser/estar Verb to go: ir Verb Tener/Necesitar/Querer Ir a Negation Subject pronouns/difference between Tú/Usted Gender and number of nouns/definite/indefinite articles Some adjectives including cuánto/a The expression “Hay” Basic geography, culture and food.
Skip date: No class on February 16, 2026
Source: Libcal Bccls

item.description:

Learn the fundamentals of home repair in this practical, hands-on workshop taught by Robert Haas, instructor of the popular Woodworking 101 and Advanced Woodworking classes. Held at Montclair High School, this course gives participants a behind-the-walls look at how common home features are built and maintained.
During the class, instructor Rob Haas will construct two demonstration walls that include doors and a window, showing how these elements are installed and how typical wall structures are assembled. Participants will also learn how traditional double-hung windows operate and how they can be repaired, including basic glass pane replacement.

We will meet near the fishing pond entrance of the park, close to Brookside Avenue and the boat house/restrooms. **GPS location: 138 Brookside Ave, Caldwell. Park on the street.**
We will walk for about 60-90 minutes at about a 3 miles/hour pace. The park has a paved path loop that is a little more than a mile. Stay for as many loops as you like.
Grover Cleveland Park in Caldwell/Essex Fells celebrated its centennial in 2013. As the first county park in western Essex County, the site was originally selected for its natural beauty and its potential to provide a space for relaxation and recreation. It contains gentle rolling hills, broad meadows and other environmentally aesthetic features

item.title: Simple Sitting Meditation (15 minutes) — Wed Sep 23, 11:00 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream
